audience: Founders and support leads keeping every account healthy and every ticket answered

bots.why: Quarterly review pack: health, wins, risks, expansion options, with evidence per slide
First-response drafts: acknowledges, triages, and proposes next step within SLA
Support inbox triage: urgent first, spam out, everything routed with an owner
Customer-call brief: health, open tickets, promises made last time
Human gate for credits, refunds, SLA exceptions, and public replies

human_steps: Connect Gmail and Calendar via first-party OAuth toggles
Install sheets-mcp for the account-health ledger and docs-mcp for QBR packs
Approve SLA targets (first reply, resolution) and the credit/refund approval threshold
Review the first 20 triaged tickets before trusting auto-routing
Approve the QBR template and the evidence-per-row rule
name: Success Support
policies: EVIDENCE-PER-ROW: every health score and QBR claim links its source ticket, run, or ledger row
SLA-FIRST: urgent and SLA-near-breach tickets route before all other work
CREDIT-GATE: credits, refunds, and SLA exceptions need human approval via approval-desk
NO-AUTO-SEND-EXTERNAL: no customer-facing reply sends without human approval

routines.name: inbox-sweep
routines.prompt_hint: Triage overnight tickets: urgent first, route each with owner and SLA clock

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.prompt_hint: Accounts near SLA breach, churn-risk flags, today's customer calls

routines.name: qbr-prep
routines.prompt_hint: Assemble QBR pack for upcoming reviews; every claim cites its evidence row

tagline: Inbox triaged daily, accounts watched weekly, QBRs backed by evidence on every row
